name: Feature adoption
prompt: Feature adoption: weekly events by feature and by region over the year, with adoption KPIs.

binding.sql: SELECT SUM(events) AS events FROM feature_adoption

copy.title: Total events
copy.caption: 4.5M feature events logged over the year.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(active_accounts),0) AS avg_active FROM feature_adoption

copy.title: Avg weekly active
copy.caption: About 30 accounts active per feature each week.

binding.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT feature) AS features FROM feature_adoption
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS regions FROM feature_adoption
SELECT week AS week, feature AS feature, SUM(events) AS events FROM feature_adoption GROUP BY week, feature ORDER BY week, feature

copy.title: Weekly events by feature
copy.caption: All five features see steady weekly usage, led narrowly by the API.

binding.sql: SELECT week AS week, region AS region, SUM(events) AS events FROM feature_adoption GROUP BY week, region ORDER BY week, region

copy.title: Weekly events by region
copy.caption: Regional usage moves together — no single market is breaking away.
